title: The mission ledger: notes, proposals and decisions about the team's mission, and the guide's six operations
why: SMC-M01 replaces the brief ritual with a mission-aware companion. The mission ledger is the application's current view of canonical project records: the accepted mission stays in project_revisions and the project's mission revision; a proposal is a decisions row; a note is a mission entry whose text is a project source with its author and turn (db/migrations/0018). The ledger revision moves with every note, proposal and decision, separately from the mission revision.

Members read one MissionContext (the same read model the voice guide's project_status uses), and write notes, corrections, withdrawals, proposals and decisions under their own identity, each idempotent per member and key, with stale revisions answered as conflicts. A withdrawal erases the note's text and advances the project's eligibility revision. Voice note capture is off until an admin turns it on, and each member's own consent is required for notes and proposals from their turns.

The media bridge's guide has six model-facing operations, fixed by the M01 v1.1 prompt: project_status, read_selected_source, record_mission_note, propose_mission_change, decide_mission_change and control_work. start_brief is removed. MediaToolCall gains `utterance`, the holder utterances the bridge has forwarded in its provider session, so a voice decision can be bound to an answer given after the proposal was put. MediaToolResult gains the write outcomes committed, proposed, conflict, denied and unknown. MediaAssignment carries the project's mission, ledger and eligibility revisions, so the bridge refreshes Sophia's context when the ledger moves and rebuilds it when eligibility narrows. /v1/media/tool-surface lets the bridge check, before activating the guide, that the API executes exactly the operations it declares.
New draft_brief admission is retired: POST native-tasks answers 410 before any write. Existing briefs, their results, their controls and their one-time result notices are unchanged.
